moments.title: UK Heatwave incoming
moments.blurb: A widespread heatwave is forecast for much of England and Wales next week, with temperatures potentially reaching 37°C in some areas by Friday, August 14th.

angles.name: Heatwave Alert
angles.copy: Get ready for a serious heatwave! Temperatures across England and Wales are set to soar next week, with some spots hitting a scorching 37°C. Stay cool and hydrated!

angles.name: Regional Forecast
angles.copy: Devon, brace yourselves! Next week is looking seriously hot, with temperatures climbing towards heatwave levels across the South West. Time to plan those beach trips carefully!

angles.name: North/South Split
angles.copy: While England and Wales bake in a heatwave next week, Scotland and Northern Ireland are expecting cooler temperatures and rain. Classic British summer split!

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament culminates with Finals Day at Lord's on Sunday, August 16th, featuring both the men's and women's finals.

angles.name: Finals Countdown
angles.copy: It's almost time! The Hundred Finals Day is set for Lord's this Sunday, August 16th. Who are you backing to lift the trophy in the men's and women's competitions?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Hopes
angles.copy: Can Welsh Fire make it to Lord's? The Hundred Finals Day is just over a week away! Keep an eye on their remaining matches to see if they can make a push for the title.

angles.name: Cricket Excitement
angles.copy: The 100-ball action has been incredible, and it all comes down to Finals Day next Sunday. Get ready for some explosive cricket!

moments.title: F1 Dutch Grand Prix
moments.blurb: Formula 1 heads to Zandvoort for the Dutch Grand Prix from August 21st to 23rd, the next race on the 2026 calendar.

angles.name: Next Race Up
angles.copy: After a brief break, F1 is back! The Dutch Grand Prix is up next, roaring into Zandvoort from August 21st-23rd. Who's your pick for the win?

angles.name: Verstappen's Home Race
angles.copy: Max Verstappen's home crowd will be out in force at Zandvoort for the Dutch Grand Prix. Expect an electric atmosphere next week!

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his After Hours Til Dawn Stadium Tour to Wembley Stadium for five nights, starting Thursday, August 14th.

angles.name: Wembley Weekend
angles.copy: London is ready! The Weeknd kicks off his five-night residency at Wembley Stadium next Thursday. Who's heading to see the After Hours Til Dawn tour?

angles.name: London Calling
angles.copy: The Weeknd is taking over Wembley for five massive nights starting next week! Get ready for some epic stadium vibes.

moments.title: Ariana Grande O2 Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande begins her highly anticipated 10-night Eternal Sunshine Tour residency at London's O2 Arena on Friday, August 15th.

angles.name: Grande Return
angles.copy: After six years, Ariana Grande is back! Her 'Eternal Sunshine' tour kicks off a massive 10-night O2 residency next Friday. Who managed to get tickets?

angles.name: London's Pop Event
angles.copy: It's the pop event of the summer! Ariana Grande starts her incredible O2 residency next week. London is about to get even more fabulous.

moments.title: Hollywood Vampires at Cardiff Castle
moments.blurb: Hollywood Vampires, featuring Alice Cooper, Joe Perry, and Johnny Depp, play a sold-out show at Cardiff Castle on Thursday, August 14th.

angles.name: Vampires in Cardiff
angles.copy: Cardiff Castle is about to get a dose of rock royalty! Hollywood Vampires hit the stage next Thursday for a sold-out show. Who's ready?

angles.name: Rock Supergroup
angles.copy: Alice Cooper, Joe Perry, Johnny Depp... Hollywood Vampires are bringing their supergroup swagger to Cardiff next week for what's sure to be an unforgettable night of rock!

moments.title: Jimmy Eat World at Cardiff Castle
moments.blurb: Jimmy Eat World celebrate 25 years of 'Bleed American' with a sold-out show at Cardiff Castle on Friday, August 15th, supported by Rise Against.

angles.name: Bleed American Anniversary
angles.copy: A huge one for emo fans! Jimmy Eat World are celebrating 25 years of 'Bleed American' at Cardiff Castle next Friday. It's sold out, but who remembers their first listen?

angles.name: Cardiff Rock
angles.copy: Jimmy Eat World and Rise Against at Cardiff Castle next week! Sounds like the perfect Friday night for rock and alternative fans. Who's going?

moments.title: Edinburgh International & Fringe Festivals
moments.blurb: The Edinburgh International Festival and the Edinburgh Fringe Festival are in full swing throughout August, bringing world-class arts and entertainment to the Scottish capital.

angles.name: Festival City Buzz
angles.copy: Edinburgh is absolutely buzzing! The International and Fringe Festivals are packed with incredible shows, comedy, music, and theatre all month. What are you seeing?

angles.name: Scottish Arts
angles.copy: From world-class theatre to stand-up comedy, the Edinburgh Festivals are showcasing the best of arts and culture right now. Immerse yourself!

moments.title: Live From Wythenshawe Park Series
moments.blurb: The 'Live From Wythenshawe Park' concert series in Manchester continues throughout August with major acts including The Cure (Aug 21), Lewis Capaldi (Aug 22), Pulp (Aug 28), The Courteeners (Aug 29), and The Prodigy (Aug 30).

angles.name: Manchester Summer Gigs
angles.copy: Wythenshawe Park is hosting some HUGE names this month! The Cure, Lewis Capaldi, Pulp, The Courteeners, and The Prodigy are all playing. Which one are you most excited for?

angles.name: Indie Legends
angles.copy: Pulp and The Courteeners bringing the indie anthems to Wythenshawe Park later this month. Get ready for some singalongs!

moments.title: Bruce Dickinson's Birthday
moments.blurb: Bruce Dickinson, the iconic frontman of Iron Maiden, turns 68 today, August 7th.

source.l: Bored Panda / This Day in Rock History

angles.name: Metal Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to the one and only Bruce Dickinson! The Iron Maiden frontman is still rocking harder than ever. What's your favourite Maiden track?

angles.name: Up The Irons!
angles.copy: Celebrating Bruce Dickinson's 68th today! A true legend of rock, pilot, fencer, author... is there anything he can't do? Raise a glass to the Iron Maiden icon!

moments.title: Christian Chávez's Birthday
moments.blurb: Christian Chávez, known for his role in the telenovela 'Rebelde' and as a member of the pop group RBD, turns 43 today, August 7th.

angles.name: RBD Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 43rd birthday to Christian Chávez! From 'Rebelde' to RBD, he's given us so many bops. What's your favourite RBD song?

moments.title: Jacquie O'Sullivan's Birthday
moments.blurb: Jacquie O'Sullivan, former member of the iconic 80s pop group Bananarama, turns 66 today, August 7th.

angles.name: Bananarama Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to Jacquie O'Sullivan, who brought us so many hits as part of Bananarama! What's your favourite 80s dance track?

moments.title: Madonna's Birthday
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, will celebrate her 68th birthday on Sunday, August 16th.

angles.name: Queen of Pop's Big Day
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! Madonna turns 68 this Sunday, August 16th. What's the ultimate Madonna track you'll be spinning?

angles.name: Iconic Madonna
angles.copy: From 'Like a Virgin' to 'Vogue' and beyond, Madonna has defined pop for decades. We're counting down to her 68th birthday this weekend!

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle's Birthday
moments.blurb: Belinda Carlisle, lead singer of The Go-Go's and successful solo artist, turns 68 on Monday, August 17th.

angles.name: Heaven Is A Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th to the incredible Belinda Carlisle this Monday! From The Go-Go's to her solo hits, she's a true 80s icon. What's your favourite track from her?

moments.title: UK Summer Holiday Season
moments.blurb: Schools across England and Wales are currently enjoying their summer holidays, with most returning in early September, while Scottish schools are preparing to return mid-August.

angles.name: Summer Vibes
angles.copy: It's still peak summer holiday season for many across the UK! What are your plans for soaking up the last few weeks before school returns?

angles.name: Back To School Prep
angles.copy: While some are still enjoying the break, Scottish schools are heading back soon! For England and Wales, there's still time to enjoy before the September return. How are you making the most of it?

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: The latest Official Singles Chart is out! Who's at Number 1 this week and what new tracks are making a splash? Tune in to Nation Hits to hear them!

angles.name: New Music Friday
angles.copy: It's Friday, which means a fresh Official Singles Chart! Discover the UK's hottest tracks right now and see if your favourites made the cut.
